description: Operator-approved lead selections for the customer workbook's WEEKLY BRIEF. Where a week has been reviewed by hand, this records which of the already-qualified supplier matches were judged the strongest commercial examples FOR THAT CUSTOMER, and they are the leads that carry TOP MATCH. Where no entry exists — every automated week — the generator falls back to the top of the supplier-specific fit order from src/sales/matching.py.
usage_note: Presentation only. A trade mark listed here is shown more prominently; it is never scored differently, never promoted past qualification, and never admitted to a workbook it did not already qualify for. A number that is not in the week's qualified matches is skipped with a warning rather than added. Removing this file changes the order of the brief and nothing else.

selections.note: kWh Coffee, BULLITT and CHAI MAMA: the three cleanest single-range launch examples for short-run flexible packaging this week — coffee, an energy bar and tea. Sami's Superfoods stays a qualified match and appears next on fit, but a five-year-old company already selling direct is a weaker launch example for this supplier than the three above, whatever its general band.
